messages:
ben: Heads up — I'm abroad and my digital insurance card shows as 'expired' when I pull it up. I need an urgent optometry appointment today for a prescription. Anyone know the fastest way to get temporary proof? :grimacing:

tara (Benefits): Sorry to hear that, ben. Do you have your member ID number? Sometimes the carrier will accept the number + a screenshot of the portal while we sort a temporary document.

ben: Member ID: 987654321. I can take a screenshot but the portal shows expiry banner. I don't have my physical card with me.

maria (People Ops): @ben — you can request a temporary ID from the benefits portal: https://benefits.redwood.com/ids (select "Temporary ID / Proof of Coverage"). It typically issues a PDF within 24 hours, sometimes faster if you mark "urgent".

jenkins-deploy-bot: Request 8421 created by ben for temporary ID — status: queued.

ben: 24 hours is risky, appointment is in ~6 hours. Is there a carrier phone number we can call to get same-day confirmation?

tara (Benefits): Call the carrier's customer service for same-day verification — their international line is +1-800-555-0123 (press 2 for ID cards). If you ask them to fax/email an authorization letter to the clinic they sometimes do it immediately. I'll also escalate on our end.

jonathan (Engineering): If it helps, take a screenshot of the member page showing name + member ID + plan name and the timestamp. Clinics usually accept that with a staff note. Also try showing the app's last updated timestamp.

maria (People Ops): I can email the clinic directly if you share the appointment time and clinic contact — include the appointment confirmation and I'll attach the member page screenshot. If you want me to do that, DM the clinic phone/email here.

ben: Clinic email is rx-eye-clinic@exampleclinic.org, appt 15:30 local. Thanks. I'm DMing the screenshot now.

tara (Benefits): Sending carrier escalation now. For claims: keep the receipt and the visit note — we can file an out-of-network urgent claim if they insist later. Also, if they need a temporary ID PDF faster than 24h, reply to this thread and I'll mark it urgent with the carrier contact.

hr-bot: Automated notice — Benefits escalation submitted (case #B-1845). Expected carrier response window: 4–48 hours. If you need proof under 4 hours, call the carrier directly.

ben: Clinic accepted the screenshot + my passport. They scanned it and said they'd bill with the member ID. THANKS all. If anything gets denied, I'll upload docs to the portal. :relieved:

tara (Benefits): Great — please also upload the itemized receipt and any Rx to the benefits portal under Claims > Add Claim > Out-of-Network (urgent) so we can fast-track reimbursement. I'll set a reminder to follow up tomorrow morning.

maria (People Ops): Filing a quick internal note that ben had a temporary acceptance to avoid duplicate outreach. Ben — ping if the clinic asks for anything else.

ben: Will do. Appreciate the quick help! :pray:
